phase1.evidence: Static code (correction of round-1 generic Data, L-007 spot check): CLC / ADC $00,X / BCC $85E7 / INC $01,X / RTS = add A to the 16-bit little-endian word at zero page X,X+1. Internally consistent control flow (the BCC displacement skips exactly the 2-byte INC to the RTS), placed right after StartMusic RTS ($85DF) and before the channel mask tables; no driver instruction reads $85E0-$85E7 as data (abs,x/y operands start at $85E8). phase1.evidence: Static recursive descent from reset/NMI/IRQ vectors, observed fetch roots and bounded jump tables (fallthrough/branch/JSR/JMP, constant-flag branch pruning, bank tracked via LDA #imm/JSR $C05A); clean decode with no invalid opcodes; not itself observed executing. Fixed bank 7 at $C000-$FFFF; the $8000 slot in the view is nominal (switch bank varies by caller).
phase1.label: Reset

regions.summary: Power-on / reset stub (present at the end of every bank so any bank mapped at $C000 works): disable rendering, reset MMC1 and set control $1E (16K PRG, $C000 fixed, vertical/horizontal per bits), select PRG bank 0 and jump to ColdStart.

units.summary: Power-on / reset stub (present at the end of every bank so any bank mapped at $C000 works): disable rendering, reset MMC1 and set control $1E (16K PRG, $C000 fixed, vertical/horizontal per bits), select PRG bank 0 and jump to ColdStart.

phase1.evidence: 6502 NMI/RESET/IRQ vector words ($C86F/$FFBF/$C8D2) at the top of this 16K bank; identical in every bank for MMC1 power-on safety.
